enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.
Sonic Blast 4: This weapon rings with the power of sound, dealing 4d6 Sonic damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Sonic damage on a critical hit.
Construct Bane 4: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt creations, dealing an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Constructs.
Armor-Piercing 15%: Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
Move Silently -10: Passive: -10 penalty to the Move Silently skill.
